children: is using its 2026 Roblox Developers Conference to mark its 20th anniversary and present a strategy centered on "more play, more building, and more growth." RDC is the company’s annual, invite-only event for developers and other creators who make games and virtual items on Roblox. Importantly, the event is where Roblox
typically announces new platform tools, game engine updates, discovery changes, and ways for creators to earn money.
The headliner on Friday was the Roblox Everywhere reveal, which will let creators distribute Roblox

experiences as standalone apps on mobile, PC, and consoles while relying on the company's underlying technology and services. By the end of 2026, Roblox also plans to let users open games directly in Google Chrome from an experience’s details page, eliminating the need to install the Roblox app, with support for other browsers planned for later.

also said it is working on offline solo play, with an early-access version expected before a broader release targeted for mid-2027. New social features include a Friends chat tab that carries across games.
For game makers, the company previewed Build, a prompt-based, mobile-focused creation tool designed to make game development more accessible to people without prior Studio experience. Roblox

said 9K games had been published through Build’s New Zealand alpha by September 1, and 71% of its creators had not previously used Roblox Studio. The alpha version is expanding to Serbia and Singapore.

The company also announced an upcoming Scene Generator functionality, which will allow creators to use a text prompt and reference image to produce an editable game scene. Other development updates aim to better support 2D, puzzle, turn-based, and asynchronous multiplayer games, including new camera, sprite, interface, and notification tools.

Roblox is revising discovery to better match games with age groups, promoting shorter experiences for younger players and more involved, repeat-play games for older users. It also expanded Moments, its short-form gameplay-video feed, and plans to add shopping features that let users buy virtual items or backgrounds featured in videos.
In terms of boosting creator income potential, Roblox

introduced Wallet, a Creator Hub financial account for eligible U.S.-based independent creators age 18 and older. It will make cleared earnings available in real currency each business day, beginning later this year. A linked Roblox Card is planned for 2027.
Roblox said creators have earned more than $5B through its Developer Exchange program since 2013, including about $1.7B in the past year.
moved up 1.5% in late Friday afternoon trading.

title: Roblox rolls out a wave of new features at RDC 2026
